# Metric library

Define each number goals are measured by once (its meaning and calculation, unit, direction, source and owner), and say which metric measures a goal, for a team or the whole company.

Module id `metrics`, in [src/modules/metrics/](../../../src/modules/metrics/module.json).

## Requirements

- `METRICS-PAGE`: Data has a Metrics page at /data/metrics: every metric in the library with its unit, which way is better, its owner, how many goals it measures and which teams use them (a company-wide link counts as the whole company), searchable by name. One form adds and edits a metric: name, unit and direction required; meaning and calculation, decimals, source and its owner, refresh, owner and caveats optional. Anyone adds; its owner or an admin edits or removes. It is the metrics module (src/modules/metrics).
- `MEASURED-BY`: New goal and goal edit offer Measured by: pick a metric from the library (those in the goal's unit first) or create one in place, for the goal's team or the whole company, with the link's problems shown before saving. A goal can change its metric freely. The goal's page shows its metric, what it means, the slice and the goal's target in it.
